facts.text: John went camping in the mountains last year.

evidence.quote: This was my Rocky Mountains trip last year and it was stunning.

facts.text: John found the experience of being in the mountains to be peaceful and refreshing.

evidence.quote: I loved just chilling and taking in the beauty of nature. It was super peaceful and refreshing.

facts.text: John described the mountains as stunning and noted the fresh air and natural beauty.

evidence.quote: Seeing those mountains, fresh air - it makes you realize how incredible the world is.

facts.text: Tim agreed with John's sentiment that nature has a calming effect on the soul.

evidence.quote: Yeah, nature's great for clearing the mind and calming the soul.
